# Draft: efficient transformers for battery health
We build on the transformer architecture (arxiv:1706.03762) and on AlphaFold (doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2). Our method also extends the fabricated prior work (arxiv:2099.99999) and a nonexistent study (doi:10.9999/fake.nonexistent.2099). On our benchmark we reach an accuracy improvement of 12.4% over the baseline, while the reported energy reduction of 88.8% is not in any log.
